pli-tv-kd3:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-kd3:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ vassāvāso apaññatto hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:1.1.3: tedha bhikkhū hemantampi gimhampi vassampi cārikaṃ caranti.
pli-tv-kd3:1.2.2: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā hemantampi gimhampi vassampi cārikaṃ carissanti, haritāni tiṇāni sammaddantā, ekindriyaṃ jīvaṃ viheṭhentā, bahū khuddake pāṇe saṅghātaṃ āpādentā?
pli-tv-kd3:1.2.3: ime hi nāma aññatitthiyā durakkhātadhammā vassāvāsaṃ allīyissanti. saṅkāsayissanti.
pli-tv-kd3:1.2.4: ime hi nāma sakuntakā rukkhaggesu kulāvakāni karitvā vassāvāsaṃ allīyissanti. saṅkāsayissanti.
pli-tv-kd3:1.2.5: ime hi pana samaṇā sakyaputtiyā hemantampi gimhampi vassampi cārikaṃ caranti, haritāni tiṇāni sammaddantā, ekindriyaṃ jīvaṃ viheṭhentā, bahū khuddake pāṇe saṅghātaṃ āpādentā”ti.
pli-tv-kd3:1.3.1: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd3:1.3.2: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd3:1.3.3: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd3:2.2.6: aparajjugatāya āsāḷhiyā purimikā upagantabbā. māsagatāya āsāḷhiyā pacchimikā upagantabbā.
pli-tv-kd3:3.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū vassaṃ upagantvā antarāvassaṃ cārikaṃ caranti.

pli-tv-kd3:3.1.6: ime pana samaṇā sakyaputtiyā hemantampi gimhampi vassampi cārikaṃ caranti haritāni tiṇāni sammaddantā, ekindriyaṃ jīvaṃ viheṭhentā, bahū khuddake pāṇe saṅghātaṃ āpādentā”ti.
pli-tv-kd3:3.2.1: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd3:3.2.2: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti, khīyanti, vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd3:3.2.3: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū vassaṃ upagantvā antarāvassaṃ cārikaṃ carissantī?”ti.
pli-tv-kd3:3.2.4: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.

pli-tv-kd3:3.2.6: “na bhikkhave, vassaṃ upagantvā purimaṃ vā temāsaṃ pacchimaṃ vā temāsaṃ avasitvā cārikā pakkamitabbā.
pli-tv-kd3:4.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū na icchanti vassaṃ upagantuṃ.
pli-tv-kd3:4.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū tadahu vassūpanāyikāya vassaṃ anupagantukāmā sañcicca āvāsaṃ atikkamanti.
pli-tv-kd3:4.2.3: “na bhikkhave, tadahu vassūpanāyikāya vassaṃ anupagantukāmena sañcicca āvāso atikkamitabbo.
pli-tv-kd3:4.3.1: tena kho pana samayena rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro vassaṃ ukkaḍḍhitukāmo bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pāhesi:
pli-tv-kd3:5.1.1: atha kho bhagavā rājagahe yathābhirattaṃ viharitvā yena sāvatthi, tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd3:5.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena sāvatthi, tadavasari.
pli-tv-kd3:5.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd3:5.1.4: tena kho pana samayena kosalesu janapade udenena upāsakena saṅghaṃ uddissa vihāro kārāpito hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:5.1.6: “āgacchantu bhadantā, icchāmi dānaṃ ca dātuṃ, dhammaṃ ca sotuṃ, bhikkhū ca passitu”nti.
pli-tv-kd3:5.2.3: na vassaṃ upagantvā purimaṃ vā temāsaṃ pacchimaṃ vā temāsaṃ avasitvā cārikā pakkamitabbāti.
pli-tv-kd3:5.2.4: āgametu udeno upāsako yāva bhikkhū vassaṃ vasanti.
pli-tv-kd3:5.2.6: sace panassa accāyikaṃ karaṇīyaṃ, tattheva āvāsikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ santike vihāraṃ patiṭṭhāpetū”ti.

pli-tv-kd3:6.14.2: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya:
pli-tv-kd3:6.14.3: ‘kukkuccaṃ me uppannaṃ. āgacchantu ayyā. icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgata’nti. gantabbaṃ bhikkhave, sattāhakaraṇīyena appahitepi pageva pahite:
pli-tv-kd3:6.14.4: ‘kukkuccaṃ vinodessāmi vā, vinodāpessāmi vā, dhammakathaṃ vāssā karissāmī’ti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.15.1: “idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuṇiyā diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti.

pli-tv-kd3:6.15.4: ‘diṭṭhigataṃ vivecessāmi vā, vivecāpessāmi vā, dhammakathaṃ vāssā karissāmī’ti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.16.1: “idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuṇī garudhammaṃ ajjhāpannā hoti mānattārahā.
pli-tv-kd3:6.16.2: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya:

pli-tv-kd3:6.17.1: “idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuṇī mūlāya paṭikassanārahā hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.17.2: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya:
pli-tv-kd3:6.17.3: ‘ahaṃ hi mūlāya paṭikassanārahā āgacchantu ayyā. icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgata’nti. gantabbaṃ bhikkhave, sattāhakaraṇīyena appahitepi pageva pahite:
pli-tv-kd3:6.18.2: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya:
pli-tv-kd3:6.18.3: ‘ahaṃ hi abbhānārahā āgacchantu ayyā. icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgata’nti. gantabbaṃ bhikkhave, sattāhakaraṇīyena appahitepi pageva pahite:
pli-tv-kd3:6.19.1: “idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuṇiyā saṅgho kammaṃ kattukāmo hoti
pli-tv-kd3:6.19.2: tajjanīyaṃ vā niyassaṃ vā, pabbājanīyaṃ vā paṭisāraṇīyaṃ vā ukkhepanīyaṃ vā.
pli-tv-kd3:6.19.3: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya:
pli-tv-kd3:6.19.4: ‘saṅgho me kammaṃ kattukāmo āgacchantu ayyā. icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgata’nti. gantabbaṃ bhikkhave, sattāhakaraṇīyena appahitepi pageva pahite:
pli-tv-kd3:6.19.5: ‘kinti nu kho saṅgho kammaṃ na kareyya? lahukāya vā pariṇāmeyyā’ti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.20.2: tajjanīyaṃ vā niyassaṃ vā pabbājanīyaṃ vā paṭisāraṇīyaṃ vā ukkhepanīyaṃ vā.
pli-tv-kd3:6.20.3: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya:
pli-tv-kd3:6.20.4: ‘saṅgho me kammaṃ akāsi. āgacchantu ayyā. icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgata”nti. gantabbaṃ bhikkhave, sattāhakaraṇīyena appahitepi. pageva pahite:
pli-tv-kd3:6.20.5: ‘kinti nu kho sammā vatteyya? lomaṃ pāteyya? netthāraṃ vatteyya? saṅgho taṃ kammaṃ paṭippassambheyyā’ti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.21.2: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya:
pli-tv-kd3:6.21.3: ‘ahaṃ hi gilānā. āgacchantu ayyā. icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgata’nti. gantabbaṃ bhikkhave, sattāhakaraṇīyena appahitepi pageva pahite:
pli-tv-kd3:6.21.4: ‘gilānabhattaṃ vā pariyesissāmi, gilānupaṭṭhāka bhattaṃ vā pariyesissāmi, gilānabhesajjaṃ vā pariyesissāmi, pucchissāmi vā, upaṭṭhahissāmi vā’ti.

pli-tv-kd3:6.23.2: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya:

pli-tv-kd3:7.5.1: “idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhussa bhātā gilāno hoti.

pli-tv-kd3:7.6.1: “idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhussa bhaginī gilānā hoti.

pli-tv-kd3:7.8.2: so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya:
pli-tv-kd3:7.8.3: ‘ahaṃ hi gilāno. āgacchantu bhadantā. icchāmi bhadantānaṃ āgata’nti. gantabbaṃ bhikkhave, sattāhakaraṇīyena pahite na tveva appahite.
